hint_profiles: A profile writes one value per interval of the day into all its data points. Create profiles and folders in the tree on the left. Changes take effect after saving: the instance restarts.
hint_intervals: Drag a bar up or down to set the value of the interval. Hold Shift and move the mouse to change several bars at once. The value is written at the beginning of every interval and when the instance starts.
hint_days: The profile runs only on the selected days. On holidays it runs too if the holiday button is on. This button appears only after a holiday ID is set in the advanced settings.
hint_priority: If a data point is in several profiles that run at the same time, the profile with the higher priority writes the value. The same data point in two profiles with the same priority on the same day is an error.
hint_priority_short: If a data point is in several running profiles, the higher priority wins
hint_type: The type decides which data points can be added and which value is written. When adding, only the data points that fit the type are offered. Data points of type mixed fit every type.
hint_type_percent: Data points with min and max, or with unit %. 0-100 % is scaled between min and max of the data point.
hint_type_temperature: Data points of type number. The value is written unchanged. The range of the bars is taken from min and max of the first data point, otherwise 0-28°.
hint_type_onoff: Data points of type boolean. true or false is written.
hint_type_custom: Data points of type number. The value is written unchanged. The range of the bars is taken from the states or min and max of the first data point, otherwise 0-100.
hint_activation: The adapter creates a state for every profile, and the profile runs only while this state is true. Instead, you can select your own boolean state, e.g. for presence or vacation.
hint_activation_short: The profile runs only while this state is true
hint_advanced: Open them with the button in the settings card. The first two options are stored per profile, the holiday ID applies to all profiles.
hint_ignore_same: An interval with the same value as the interval before writes nothing. So a manual change is kept until the value in the profile changes.
hint_do_not_write_same: The current value of the data point is read first and written only if it differs.
hint_holiday_id: Boolean state that is true on holidays, e.g. from the feiertage adapter. Then the holiday button appears next to the days of week.
hint_no_devices: No data points yet. Add the data points this profile controls.

hint_range: Own range of the bars. Empty fields are taken from the first data point or the defaults.
hint_values: With a value list, the bars choose one of the entries. The adapter writes the value of the entry or the current value of its state, e.g. a comfort temperature.
hint_type_custom_list: Data points of type number, string or boolean. The value of the chosen entry of the value list is written, converted to the type of the data point.
hint_values_help: Temperature and custom profiles can have their own range of the bars (min, max and step), e.g. 30-60° for hot water. A custom profile can also have a value list: every entry has a label and a value, e.g. off/low/high, "on"/"off" as text or the levels 0-3 of a ventilation. Instead of a fixed value, an entry can take the value of a state, e.g. a comfort and an eco temperature that you change in vis. If such a state changes, the new value is written at once.
